subject: general
question: Which of the following is taken as the base year for the calculation of Wholesale Price Index (WPI) by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** __2011-12.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **WPI is mostly used as a GDP **deflator and measures the average movement of wholesale** prices of commodities.**
 
• Compared to June 2022, in July 2022. **Weight 24.38% WPI Food Index:** The Food Index fell from 178.4 in June 2022 to 174.4 in July 2022, consisting of **"Food Articles"** from the Primary Articles group and "Food Product" from the Manufactured Products group.
 
• In India,** the Ministry of Commerce and Industry's WPI serves **as the basis for calculating inflation rates.
 
• The first register, from 1915, included** Wholesale Price Indices **as well as Calcutta Wholesale Price Indices. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **WPI is compiled and published by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry.** The Office first released the index number of wholesale prices starting with the week beginning January 10, 1942, with a base week ending August 19, 1939=100. The index has been** routinely published since 1947.**
 
• An** index that tracks and measures price** changes for items in the stages prior to retail is known as **the wholesale price index.**
